brief:
The Republican losses in US midterms are complicating Benjamin Netanyahu's political standing ahead of Israel's elections, as his close alignment with the Republican party becomes a liability, Al Jazeera English reported. Netanyahu has long cultivated relationships with Republican figures, but the GOP's midterm setback threatens to undermine one of his key political assets in the Israeli race.

The shift reflects broader concerns among Israeli voters about Netanyahu's international positioning as the country approaches the polls. His rivals are capitalizing on the midterm results to challenge his credibility and strategic judgment, turning what was once a source of political strength into a vulnerability.
dek: The Republican midterm rout is helping shape who leads Israel next, as Netanyahu’s US ties turn toxic.
title: Netanyahu's US ties weaken as midterm results reshape Israeli election
